title: Pure Clear World
summary: Clear World is Nightshroud's Attributeless control archetype centered around the Clear World Field Spell, which punishes both players based on the Attributes of monsters they control. Because all 'Clear' monsters are treated as having NO Attribute while face-up on the field, you completely bypass Clear World's penalties while locking down the opponent's hand, attacks, and backrow.

allow.Planet Pathfinder: Tributes itself to add Clear World directly from the Deck to the hand.
allow.Terraforming: Searches the essential Clear World Field Spell.
allow.Radian, the Multidimensional Kaiju: Tributes an opponent's monster to give them a DARK Attribute monster, forcing Clear World's DARK penalty.
allow.Dogoran, the Mad Flame Kaiju: Tributes an opponent's monster to give them a FIRE Attribute monster, inflicting 1000 burn damage during their End Phase via Clear World.

main: Level 7 Clear boss that can be Tribute Summoned with 1 monster, gains the highest ATK on the opponent's field while you have no other cards, and is unaffected by Clear World.
Level 8 Clear boss that is unaffected by Clear World, gains double the ATK of any monster it attacks, and discards 1 card to survive destruction.
Level 4 Clear monster that is unaffected by Clear World and can discard itself + another Clear card to destroy a monster and mill 3 cards from the opponent's Deck.
Level 4 Clear monster that is unaffected by Clear World and inflicts 300 burn damage per card in the opponent's hand when it inflicts battle damage.
Level 1 Clear monster that is unaffected by Clear World and summons another Clear Cube directly from the Deck when removed from the field.
Signature Field Spell that applies crippling penalties for each Attribute a player controls while leaving your Clear monsters completely immune.
Continuous Spell that searches a Clear monster mentioning Clear World, prevents Clear monsters from being destroyed by battle, and protects from high-ATK battle damage.
Tributes itself to search Clear World so you have no Attribute monsters remaining on your field.
Gives the opponent a DARK monster so Clear World prevents all of their monsters from declaring an attack.
Gives the opponent a FIRE monster so Clear World burns them for 1000 damage every End Phase.
